summary: Verified regression bug 'spinning up server'. App loads normally from browser: DOMContentLoaded 1.3s, login form visible 2.9s, dashboard loads with Total Kontrak=136 after admin login, and 3 consecutive refreshes all complete in ~2.6s with stable body content. No stuck-loading behavior observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/auth/me returns 401 on unauthenticated app root, producing 4 console errors before login. Consider suppressing or handling silently to keep console clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend regression for 'spinning up server' bug is resolved after container cold-start recovery. Initial page load ~1.3s, login form ~2.9s, dashboard renders with 136 contracts and reminder banner. Reload x3 stable. No code changes were made.
rca of the issue: Reported 'spinning up server' was caused by preview container cold-start/restart after inactivity. Once supervisor brought backend/frontend/mongodb back to RUNNING, browser loads complete normally (well under 30s). Not a code bug.
